scenes.text: This is OpenPit. A pit is a five to thirty minute trading round on one dreamDEX perp market. Someone makes a call, and everyone else either joins them, or fades them.
Opening a pit takes one form. Pick a market, a direction, and a length. No wallet needed: your position opens at the live dreamDEX mark, read on-chain.
The live card runs on Somnia Reactivity. Every event arrives with same-block eth_call results, so price and standings update the moment the chain moves.
Share the link, and players pile in. Each one goes long with the caller, or short against them, and the crowd bar moves as they arrive.
Players are ranked by return on the cap: profit divided by the same cap for everyone. A bigger account can't buy the win.
This pit ran with real orders from two wallets on Somnia testnet. At the bell, the mark is frozen at that block, and the winner is crowned.
Every real order is a dreamDEX PerpPool trade, and the server re-verifies each transaction hash from its receipt before it counts.
Here's the opening order on the Somnia explorer: a filled order on the BTC perp pool.
Each pit gets a share card for X that tags dreamDEX, with a one-click rematch.
OpenPit. Social, time-boxed trading on dreamDEX perps. Open source, and running on Cloudflare Workers.
